Value-chain productivity of about ₹420 Cr offset roughly 93% of inflation.

Free cash flow was ₹1,374 Cr and return on capital employed 28.4%.
Nao Spirits go-to-market is now fully integrated with the USL playbook.

operating_notes.text: Restated prior year consolidated NSV to reflect RCSPL as discontinued operations.
Executed amended & restated SPA for RCSPL divestment; aggregate consideration remains ₹16,660 Cr (INR 166.6 bn).
Q4FY26 beverage alcohol segment revenue was ₹3,054 Cr with EBITDA of ₹593 Cr.
FY26 NSV growth was 7.6% reported, 10.9% excluding AP and Maharashtra; P&A grew 8.6% (11.3% ex-AP & MH).
FY26 price/mix contributed 6.1% to NSV growth; A&P spend was ₹1,295 Cr at a 10.4% rate of investment.
FY26 free cash flow was ₹1,374 Cr and ROCE 28.4%; value-chain productivity of ~₹420 Cr offset ~93% of inflation.
Proposed closure of manufacturing unit at Malkajgiri, Hyderabad by 31st August 2026 under Supply Chain Agility Program.
DRI conducted search operations under Section 105 of the Customs Act, 1962 as part of an industry-wide exercise with no financial impact.
Maharashtra State Tax search conducted between Oct 19 and Oct 29, 2026, concluded with no financial impact.

timeline.summary: Released Q4FY26 preview showing consolidated net sales value of ₹3,054 Cr and FY26 net sales of ₹12,467 Cr.

United Spirits executed an amended share purchase agreement on May 11, 2026, reorganising the buyer consortium for the sale of Royal Challengers Sports Private Limited without altering the ₹16,660 Cr consideration.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹6,855 Cr, net profit ₹539 Cr (+28.0% YoY).
United Spirits reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹6,855 Cr and net profit of ₹539 Cr, and recommended a final dividend of ₹11 per share.
United Spirits reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹3,054 Cr and recommended a final dividend of ₹11 per share.
United Spirits' Q4FY26/FY26 investor presentation reported FY26 NSV growth of 7.6% (10.9% ex-AP & MH); free cash flow of ₹1,374 Cr and a dividend of ₹17.0 per share.
On May 15, 2026, United Spirits notified exchanges about the availability of the Q4FY26 investor call recording.
Diageo Relay B.V. declared no encumbrance on its USL shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
United Spirits proposed the closure of its Malkajgiri, Hyderabad manufacturing unit by August 2026 under its supply chain agility program.
On October 16, 2026, the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence conducted search operations at United Spirits as part of an industry-wide exercise.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹7,014 Cr (-2.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹428.05 Cr (-7.8% YoY) (includes ₹33 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹461 Cr).
United Spirits Limited made recording of investor call held on 29th October 2026 available on its website.
United Spirits announced the conclusion of a search operation by the Maharashtra State Tax Commissioner with no financial impact.
